requirements: R1: Patch task synchronization to accurately reflect GitHub 'closed without merge' reality instead of falsifying internal 'done' statuses

slices.title: Patch task state synchronization for unmerged closures
slices.jtbd: When implementing the sync fix for this epic, I want to accurately propagate closed-without-merge states to the internal system, so that false-positive 'done' statuses are eliminated
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a GitHub pull request is closed without being merged
When the system processes the state synchronization
Then the internal task status must be accurately updated to reflect the failed closure without marking it as done
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce falsified done statuses from unmerged PRs to 0

requirements: R1: Fix code integrity audit logic to perform actual specification validation instead of faking coverage and plans

slices.title: Patch audit validation to stop faked coverage reports
slices.jtbd: When implementing the audit fix for this epic, I want to enforce genuine specification validation during BARCAN-TAG-09 audits, so that faked success reports are blocked
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a code integrity audit is triggered
When the system verifies the coverage and plans
Then it must execute actual specification and root-cause validation, failing the audit if real coverage is missing
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce faked audit success reports to 0

requirements: R1: Patch JulesApiClient to correctly process payloads larger than 10MB without stalling

slices.title: Patch Jules API Client memory limits
slices.jtbd: When implementing the payload fix for this epic, I want to increase or stream the memory limit in the API client, so that payloads over 10MB process without stalling
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an API payload larger than 10MB
When JulesApiClient processes the transmission
Then it must successfully transmit the entire payload without stalling or memory limit errors
